archetypes.name: producer-name-audit
archetypes.rationale: The entire bug class being fixed is dead/misnamed patterns; the plan must be verified to use only real producer-emitted names throughout.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify that every exclusion pattern the plan adds to design_artifact_excluded() exactly matches the file names actually emitted by the producer scripts (dispatch-plan-review-panel.sh, dispatch-with-waterfall.sh, launch-review.sh). For each pattern variant in the plan (cursor-plan-*-output*.txt, codex-primary-plan-*-output*.txt, claude-plan-*-output*.txt and their .meta/.json/.cap-hit sidecars), cross-check against the producer grep or filename-assignment lines to confirm the prefix and suffix are correct and no real output is missed or over-excluded. Pay special attention to the dynamic-slug naming convention (e.g. codex-primary-plan-dyn-<slug>-output.txt vs cursor-plan-dyn-<slug>-output.txt) to ensure the plan's patterns cover both static-arch and dyn-slug forms without gap. Check whether the claude-plan-generic-output.txt fallback and any other assessor or vote files share any prefix that would be accidentally excluded by claude-plan-*-output*.txt. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-fixture-gap
archetypes.rationale: The plan replaces fictional test fixtures with real names; any remaining fictional or mismatched fixture name re-introduces the defect the tests are meant to catch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the planned test fixture changes in scripts/test-design-log-publish.sh and scripts/test-lib-design-round-artifacts.sh to verify that each new or renamed fixture basename is (a) a real producer-emitted name (not another fictional name), (b) actually covered by one of the new deny patterns being added, and (c) included in an assertion that checks for absence from the published output. Check that the deny-list assertion loop in test-design-log-publish.sh will be updated to include every new transcript fixture (codex-primary-plan-arch-output.txt, cursor-plan-arch-output.txt, claude-plan-generic-output.txt, the dyn-* variants, the phase2 variant, and the three sidecar-suffix variants), so a future regression where a transcript is not excluded would cause the test to fail. Verify that the plan does not accidentally discard any currently-passing happy-path assertion for canonical artifacts (plan.txt, findings.md, voting-tally.md) through a too-broad fixture rename. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
